exact_table_name: Table 1  Wait times for priority procedures, by province and Canada, 2008 to 2025
citation: Canadian Institute for Health Information. Wait Times for Priority Procedures in Canada, 2008-2025 - Data Tables. Ottawa, ON: CIHI; 2026.
fields_used: Reporting level, Province, Indicator, Metric, Data year, Unit of measurement, Indicator result
filter_applied: Reporting level = 'Provincial'; Indicator in (Hip Replacement, Knee Replacement); Data year in (2020..2024) matched as exact '<year>FY' strings, excluding all bare-year (April-September) and Q3Q4 rows
notes: Hip and knee replacement results are submitted to CIHI by provincial ministries and agencies as aggregate figures. Only Hip Fracture Repair is calculated by CIHI from DAD/NACRS, and it is not used here. Data year is April-September unless suffixed FY (April-March) or Q3Q4 (October-March). Newfoundland and Labrador published no 2024FY figures for either procedure (all metrics n/a, Table 1 rows 18790-18797); that province-year is absent rather than imputed, so this table holds 98 rows, not 100.
